issues.description: changedFiles path comparison may fail due to relative vs absolute path mismatch
issues.detail: VitestGit.findChangedFiles typically returns absolute paths, but isIncluded receives filenames that may be relative or have varying path forms. The check `this.changedFiles.includes(filename)` is a strict string equality and will silently miss matches when path formats differ (e.g., POSIX vs Windows, absolute vs relative). Coverage could be empty silently.

issues.description: globCache poisoning when changedFiles set after first isIncluded calls
issues.detail: onTestRunStart clears globCache after assigning changedFiles, but isIncluded results now depend on changedFiles in addition to glob match. If isIncluded is called concurrently or before clear during async loading, cached values from prior runs (without changedFiles filter) can be returned, leading to over-reporting. Also the cache no longer keys on whether changedFiles is set.

issues.description: onTestRunStart not awaited in parallel with _testRun.start, potential race
issues.detail: In core.ts, `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` runs after `_testRun.start(specs)` but before file execution. If any pre-test coverage hook (e.g., onAfterSuiteRun for cached files) reads changedFiles before onTestRunStart resolves on certain code paths (collectOnly, browser mode), filtering will be inconsistent. Verify all entry points call this hook.

issues.description: CLI transform incorrectly handles boolean-like inputs other than 'true'/'false'
issues.detail: The transform in cli-config.ts only accepts 'true'/'yes'/'false'/'no' as booleans, but a user passing `--coverage.changed` without a value (or with empty string) will produce a string like '' or true depending on CAC. Furthermore, a branch named literally 'true' or 'false' cannot be used as a git ref via CLI. Document or escape this collision.

issues.description: coverage.changed=true semantics undocumented and possibly broken
issues.detail: Docs state `true` means staged+unstaged changes, but onTestRunStart passes `this.options.changed` (which would be `true`) directly to `findChangedFiles({ changedSince: true })`. VitestGit.findChangedFiles expects a string ref for changedSince; passing boolean true likely fails or treats it as no ref. Confirm git module handles `true` correctly or coerce appropriately.

issues.description: Inheritance logic doesn't handle coverage.changed === false explicitly set
issues.detail: resolveConfig checks `resolved.coverage.changed === undefined`, which correctly distinguishes unset from false. However, since `changed?: boolean | string` defaults to false in some code paths, this may not always be undefined when user omits it. The test verifies the override case, but a default-merging pass elsewhere could set it to false implicitly, breaking inheritance silently.

review.summary: The PR adds a useful `coverage.changed` option, but the implementation has several concerns around path normalization between VitestGit's output and isIncluded's input (strict string compare on `includes` is fragile across OS/path-format differences), cache invalidation semantics in globCache, and CLI transform edge cases (branches literally named 'true'/'false', or `true` value being forwarded to git's `changedSince`). The inheritance logic and tests cover the happy paths well, but boolean-true handling and the onTestRunStart hook coverage across all run entry points deserve a closer look before merging.
